prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a parking lot collision. The patient had 22 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1064; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with complaints of neck and low back pain and muscle stiffness. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the findings documented at intake. Over the course of 22 visits, care consisted of manual therapy, targeted therapeutic exercise, and home exercise instruction, progressing in a typical manner for soft tissue strain. Range of motion and strength improved steadily, and visit frequency was gradually reduced as symptoms resolved. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of cervical and lumbar strain. No prior complaints or treatment involving these body regions are known from the patient history reviewed. Billed services align with the documented plan of care, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified. Patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.
